savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_8396 (EO 8396, 5 FR 1461-1464, read once in full): the 'Revocation of Executive Orders' list names EO 8177 (item 9) with no savings, pending-matter or exception clause and no effective-date wording; nothing in the order saves the revoked orders as such. Own-residual check, reading EO 8177 in full: it prescribed the retirement rules for Foreign Service officers as sec. III-19 of Part I and II-31 of Part II and cancelled the older sections III-19 to III-33 and Chapter II of Part II. Those cancellations were executed on signing and EO 8396 does not restore them. EO 8396 carries the subject forward itself: its Chapter I secs. 1-29 (retirement of persons eligible for the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System, with optional purchase of additional benefits) and 1-30 re-prescribe the same rules, and its cancellation paragraph removes Part I Chapter III, where the sec. III-19 text sat (the printed 'Chapter HE.'). Benefits under the Retirement and Disability System rest on the Act of February 23, 1931 as amended and survive in any case; the order created no fund, property or right of its own. The prefill (none_after_bounded_search) is OVERRULED to transferred_or_accrued because the function and rules were re-prescribed in a successor chapter and the earlier cancellations stand. Bounded search: EO 8177 and EO 8396 in full; the held 1939-1941 Foreign Service Regulations orders searched for sections III-19 and II-31 (only the 1941 orders EO 8671 and 8672, which postdate the revocation, mention them).

research_rationale: EO 8177 (signed 1939-06-21, 4 FR 2467), read in full from the held FR text, amends the Foreign Service Regulations by prescribing sec. III-19 of Part I and sec. II-31 of Part II (retirement of Foreign Service officers) and by cancelling Part I sections III-19 to III-33 and Chapter II of Part II. The order has no term, sunset or termination wording and no report deadline. EO 8396 (5 FR 1461, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_8396.json) names EO 8177 in its 'Revocation of Executive Orders' list ('Executive Order No. 8177, dated June 21, 1939') and states no effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1940-04-18. A by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 8177 named only in EO 8396 (other hits are document or page numbers); the Foreign Service Regulations orders of 1939-1941 contain no cancellation of sec. III-19 or II-31 before EO 8396. Inventory correction: the dossier's sole clause is the neighbouring Wyoming withdrawal order EO 8175 (the extracted text prints the number of the Foreign Service order after its column-split body), so inventory_overrides replace it with four clauses of EO 8177 itself; the page furniture inside III-19(a) forces two fragments. Initial reading: the extracted text is badly column-scrambled and the OCR garbles some words (e.g. 'HI-19', '^Eaj& I'); no operative sentence is missing. Savings: the S0 prefill is overruled, see savings_residuals.
